caption: The drawing depicts a side profile of a horse in a trotting stance, positioned on a narrow rectangular base. The horse is rendered in shades of reddish-brown and dark brown, with areas of greenish and black blotching that suggest weathering or patina, giving the appearance of an aged metal surface. The mane and tail are stylized, and the anatomical features of the horse, such as muscles and joints, are simplified into smooth contours. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no other visible objects or design elements. In the bottom right corner, the name "DOLORES A. HAUPT" is written in small, reddish-brown letters.
title: Horse Weather Vane
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
